code_explorer.summary: Fixture exploration completed: command_run is implemented as a fixed default argv runner with constrained template parameters, structured diagnostics, and bounded output artifacts.

relevant_files.reason: Defines command_run configuration, parameter validation, template rendering, execution, and diagnostics extraction.
Shows how a coding agent exposes semantic validation tools without raw shell access.
Runs the command_run regression coverage as part of the code-agent gate.

findings.title: Shell access is intentionally not exposed
findings.evidence: The fixture target uses configured argv commands and parameter policy checks instead of letting the model provide an arbitrary shell command.

findings.title: The tool supports targeted edit loops
findings.evidence: Rendered argv and diagnostics are returned in the command_run output so downstream edit modules can run a focused test and inspect file/line failures.

next_steps: Use code.explore for open-ended repository questions before invoking code.edit.
Keep commands narrow and prefer parameter policies over raw shell access.

context_compactor.summary: Fixture compacted code-review evidence covering search relevance, timeouts, provenance, diagnostics, and local verification.

retained_facts.fact: The evidence bundle includes local documents about Playwright timeouts, search relevance, provenance, and browser-backed cost controls.
The code-review gather step also reads the target script, related config, repository matches, git diff/status, and an default air-tools test result.

risks: Fixture models are deterministic and only prove orchestration/schema behavior, not model reasoning quality.
limitations: This fixture output is intentionally static for offline regression.

$sequence.rationale: Intentionally malformed fixture item that omits the tool name so the edit loop exercises observed tool-call errors.
Run the configured validation first to capture the current failure.
Read the small target before selecting a file operation.
The failing implementation subtracts on line 2; replace only that line.
Inspect the workspace diff before finishing.
The edit was applied, validation passed, and the diff was inspected.

code_edit_summarizer.rationale: The bounded tool loop read the target and test, applied a one-line edit call, and the configured fixture validation passed.

code_reviewer.summary: Fixture review completed: the composed code-review workflow gathered evidence, routed it through the standard context module, and produced schema-valid grounded guidance.

findings.title: Offline composed review path is executable
findings.evidence: The fixture run exercises search, repository context, file reads, diff/status, test execution, standard context compaction routing, and final review output.
findings.recommendation: Use this fixture run as a deterministic regression gate, and use the OpenAI-compatible config for real review quality checks.

gaps: Static fixture output does not evaluate live web search quality.

next_steps: Run the same profile with examples/bigmodel-openai-compatible.json for a real model review.
Keep fixture output small and stable so CI can assert orchestration behavior.
